contract: Preallocated private input/output/packed buffers. GPU command interval includes fresh B packing once per round and, for both, A packing every call; repeated calls alternate two activation tensors, share one immutable B, and have distinct outputs. Packing is not retained across warmup/measured rounds. Host wall includes encoding/commit/wait but excludes buffer allocation, shader loading, uploads and output verification. Every output cell and guard, packed contents/padding/guard, and input immutability are checked outside timing every round. Strict dyadic screening, not full language/non-dyadic/safety qualification. R=1 includes construction for a single use; R=8 amortizes construction within the batch. Packed workspace and total preallocated GPU bytes are recorded.
